title: Failed deletion control holds current direct contact plan
diagnosis: Lila retains ownership, but the failed turn-131 deletion control holds all Lila information. The new direct-contact recap does not reach an answer model.

checkpoint.query_text: After the old Blue Cedar details were deleted, what is my current contact plan?

selected_source_turns.text: I am fully out of Blue Cedar now. Please delete the old Blue Cedar callback line and room 12 note from shared memory.
Can you recap my current contact plan now that the old one is deleted?
Current contact recap: 510-555-0166, no detailed voicemail, and no scheduling updates to Aaron.

body.information_scope: Accepted SELF service interaction established by its original authorization receipts. Permits this subject's own responsive facts, results, instructions, resulting recommendations and continuing plan for the SAME accepted service interaction. The activity label summarizes its initial question; it is NOT a closed list of information fields. An initial history/status question does not exclude the same worker's later recommendations or follow-up instructions for that subject within that service. Use the original acceptance and worker receipts to establish continuity. Explicit source field exclusions still constrain access. Excludes unrelated service interactions and other subjects' information.
